candidate.version_description: These are the chords I figured out, not sure if they are correct to the original. They are based of the live version by Peter, Paul and Mary.

Intro:

[ch]G[/ch]


[Verse 1]

[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]
There is a ship and she sails the sea[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]D[/ch]
She's loaded deep,  as deep can be[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]Bm[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]
But not as deep as the love I'm in[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]D[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]
I know not if I sink or swim[/tab]


[Verse 2]

[tab]                [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]
I leaned my back against an oak[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]D[/ch]
Thinking it was   a trusty tree[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Bm[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
But first it bent and then it broke[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]D[/ch]                   [ch]G[/ch]
Just as my love proved false to me[/tab]


[Verse 3]

[tab]                   [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
Oh, love is gentle, and love is kind[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]
The sweetest flower  when first it's new[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]Bm[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]          [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
But love grows old and waxes cold[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]                     [ch]G[/ch]
And fades away like the mornin' dew[/tab]


[Verse 4]

[tab]                  [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
The water is wide, I cannot get o'er[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]
Neither have I    the wings to fly[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Bm[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch]
Give me a boat that can carry  two[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]D[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]
And both shall row, my love and   I[/tab]
